# Cleanroom World

> > Cleanroom World provides ISO 9001:2015 certified cleanroom furniture, laboratory casework, equipment, and supplies including HEPA filtration systems and stainless steel cabinets.

Based in Centennial, Colorado, Cleanroom World (Western States Sales Inc) specializes in cleanroom solutions with quality management certification from Orion Registrar, Inc. The company offers comprehensive customer service including shipping, returns, and technical support for laboratory and cleanroom environments.

## Key Topics

- ISO 9001:2015 certification
- Quality management systems (QMS)
- Cleanroom furniture and equipment
- Laboratory casework
- 304 stainless steel
- 316 stainless steel
- HEPA filters
- Standing height cabinets
- International Organization for Standardization (ISO)
- Orion Registrar, Inc
- Quality assurance standards
- Cleanroom supplies
- Western States Sales Inc
